body.reply:
I can't give you a quarter-by-quarter De Anza schedule. The app has no De Anza course list or quarter offerings, and its plan is built in SJSU semesters starting Spring 2027, before you start. It does show what you still need, since you have no credits yet. All of these are missing.
- Second English composition course: ENGL 1B or ENGL 2 [1]
- MATH 30 Calculus I, then MATH 31 Calculus II [2][3]. The plan puts MATH 30 before MATH 31 [4].
- MATH 39 Linear Algebra I, which the plan places after MATH 31 [5][6]
- MATH 42 Discrete Mathematics [7]. Its prerequisite is placement or MATH 19/18A+18B, and no course link is stored [8].
- CS 46A, then CS 46B [9][10]. CS 46A is a prerequisite for CS 46B [11][12].
- One major elective from CS 22A, CS 47, CS 48, CS 49J, or MATH 32. This match is low confidence with an unspecified rule [13].

The MATH and CS courses need a C- or better [2][3][5][7][9][10].

The plan also assumes every course is offered each Fall and Spring, because the catalog doesn't list terms [14]. It leaves out 9 units of Domain Field Electives, which need department approval [15]. It also doesn't cover General Education or total units [14].

Confirm with your advisor. Here's a question you can ask them:
“I'm starting at De Anza in Fall 2027 for SJSU Data Science, B.S. Which De Anza courses match MATH 30, 31, 39, 42, CS 46A, CS 46B and ENGL 1B/2 in ASSIST, and which major elective (CS 22A, CS 47, CS 48, CS 49J or MATH 32) should I take?”
